properties.notes: This site lies within the Shoreham Harbour Regeneration Area identified as a broad location for change. The regeneration of Shoreham Harbour has been a long term aspiration and and the redevelopment of the Western Harbour Arm is recognised as a priority for the Shoreham Harbour Partnership. The principle of redeveloping this site for a residential use is consistent with Joint Area Action Plan policies. SHLAA Ref:SH/006/16. Planning application submitted Feb 2020. AWDM/0204/20
